resources.string: This is a demo, not a WhatsApp chat. Cucuto plays the sound and the vibration here, in the app: nothing is posted and nothing reaches WhatsApp or the module. Your real chats show up on Home once the module sees their first message.
Plays one of the character\'s clips with its vibration, like a message from this chat would.
Choose a character under Messages to hear a sample message.
None of your packs has ringtones yet.
Calls would ring with the phone\'s own ringtone, so there\'s no sample call to play.
Get a pack first: the sample chat needs a character to speak.
